INSERT INTO customs_declaration_generate_log (declaration_no, source_type, source_order_no, source_line_id, raw_sku, standard_sku, product_code, source_location, warehouse_bucket, warehouse_name, quantity, match_status, remark, created_by) VALUES
(#{log.declarationNo}, #{log.sourceType}, #{log.sourceOrderNo}, #{log.sourceLineId}, #{log.rawSku}, #{log.standardSku}, IFNULL(#{log.productCode}, ''), #{log.sourceLocation}, #{log.warehouseBucket}, #{log.warehouseName}, #{log.quantity}, #{log.matchStatus}, #{log.remark}, #{log.createdBy})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE declaration_no = VALUES(declaration_no), raw_sku = VALUES(raw_sku), standard_sku = VALUES(standard_sku), source_location = VALUES(source_location), warehouse_name = VALUES(warehouse_name), quantity = VALUES(quantity), match_status = VALUES(match_status), remark = VALUES(remark), created_by = VALUES(created_by), created_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT standard_sku AS standardSku, IFNULL(product_code, '') AS productCode, warehouse_bucket AS warehouseBucket, SUM(IFNULL(quantity, 0)) AS quantity FROM customs_declaration_generate_log WHERE standard_sku IS NOT NULL AND standard_sku != '' AND match_status IN ('MATCHED', 'UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE') AND
(standard_sku = #{key.sku} AND IFNULL(product_code, '') = IFNULL(#{key.productCode}, ''))
GROUP BY standard_sku, IFNULL(product_code, ''), warehouse_bucket

SELECT id, declaration_no, source_type, source_order_no, source_line_id, raw_sku, standard_sku, product_code, source_location, warehouse_bucket, warehouse_name, quantity, match_status, remark, created_by, created_time FROM customs_declaration_generate_log WHERE standard_sku IS NOT NULL AND standard_sku != '' AND
(standard_sku = #{key.sku} AND IFNULL(product_code, '') = IFNULL(#{key.productCode}, ''))
ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500
